original_test_intent: Flash the designated CPLD image through the BMC OEM path and verify the exact CPLD version plus platform recovery.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: BMC WebUI OEM firmware path uploads `.ima`, preserves configuration, flashes, and checks version.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: The intended CPLD target version is active and affected platform functions remain healthy.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with physical CPLD identity, OEM method, dependency order and activation requirements.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer maps the physical CPLD and operates the OEM path; agent can analyze task, version and health evidence.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: BMC OEM WebUI CPLD flash with `.ima` image and version check.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Board/CPLD identity, image/compatibility, OEM SOP, dependency order, activation power sequence, recovery and approval.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: A generic firmware API is not equivalent unless it proves the same CPLD target and activation behavior.

original_method: The OEM WebUI method and CPLD-specific intent are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the platform vendor's exact CPLD update mechanism and component inventory; keep WebUI when no approved component-specific API exists.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board revision, CPLD and BMC OEM update stack.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Current/target CPLD and dependency compatibility required.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform vendor CPLD/OEM update SOP; no generic Redfish equivalence is assumed.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: May automate monitoring only when target and behavior are verified.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Must include affected PCIe/I2C/sensor/power functions after activation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Physical/component map, signed image, order and activation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong CPLD or power sequence can impair power sequencing and board control.

missing_inputs: Signed compatible image and OEM SOP
safety_boundaries: No wrong target/image/order or automatic retry
no_automatic_retry: A failed CPLD update stops for engineer recovery.
engineer_owned_verdict: CPLD/platform engineer owns the formal result.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already prevented a generic update workflow from erasing the OEM component-specific test intent.
